representationRule: For every non-empty State trackedObjects edge, the target must resolve to a Project identity and exactly one active Claim must represent the same State -- ecl:tracks --> Project proposition. trackedObjects remains a compatibility/review projection; the Claim is the auditable proposition. No inverse Claim-to-trackedObjects requirement is introduced by this tranche.
explicitNonGoals: Do not remove trackedObjects in this tranche.
Do not require every ecl:tracks Claim to be projected back into trackedObjects.
Do not create Agency identities or agency hierarchy for ICE, HSI, DoD, Army, or CENTCOM.
Do not infer operates, controls, participatesIn, supplier causation, culpability, or governance from State tracking.
Do not change Project dossier outcomes, Schedule, registry governance views, LICENSE, released legal artifacts, or GovernanceDecision records.
Do not materialize the deferred French national law-enforcement VSA project without a stable reviewed deployment boundary.
